description: Single source of truth for VenueDNA player badge definitions. Consumed by build_narratives.py (qualification) and fixture_harness.js / app.js (rendering). No badge constants may exist in Python or JS.

badges.label: Iron Surgeon
badges.description: Top-quintile approach and iron-play scores. Qualifies when both approach_play and iron_play percentiles exceed the minimum threshold.

badges.label: Bomber
badges.description: Top-quintile driving distance. Long hitters who generate primary scoring advantage off the tee.

badges.label: Precision Driver
badges.description: Top-quintile driving accuracy. Players who find fairways at a high rate. Mutually exclusive with Bomber when both thresholds are met, Precision Driver takes precedence.

badges.label: Par-5 Predator
badges.description: Top-quintile par-5 scoring. Exploits the reachable par-5s that separate scoring at birdie-opportunity venues.

badges.label: Putter
badges.description: Top-quintile strokes gained putting. Elite short-game conversion on any green surface.

badges.label: Hot Streak
badges.description: Top-quintile recent form score. Strong momentum entering the event based on recent starts.

badges.label: Detroit Veteran
badges.description: Three or more starts at Detroit Golf Club. Meaningful venue-specific sample exists.

badges.label: Debut
badges.description: No prior starts at Detroit Golf Club. Evidence-coverage flag applies to venue-history narrative.
